name: Kagawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kagawa town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines with a stylised character at the bottom.
history: Flag of the former town of Kagawa in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-10.

features.role: Kagawa town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines with a stylised character at the bottom
